item: the server runs only on the stdlib asyncio loop and refuses to start on uvloop
summary: uvicorn's loop=auto picked uvloop, whose resolves and connects bypass the airplane socket guard; _serve now pins loop=asyncio, and lifespan fails closed: on any loop but the stdlib's (a bare python -m uvicorn start picks uvloop) the app refuses to start with fixed words naming the launcher and --loop asyncio. Not covered: --lifespan off or a mount inside another ASGI app (no lifespan runs), and on Windows the stdlib proactor loop's IP-literal connects (ConnectEx), recorded in SECURITY.md. Release line: when started with its own launcher, the app's server now always runs on Python's own event loop instead of uvloop, so airplane mode's network guard is no longer bypassed by connections made from that loop; started through uvicorn on another loop, the app refuses to start and says how to start it.
